findings.text: Oszacuj części, zamiast podawać jedną liczbę bez wcześniejszego sprawdzenia zakresu zadania.
findings.why: The upstream gives a stopping rule for how far to split: each subtask should fit one sitting, and over-splitting itself costs time. The item drops it and does not list the drop in the adaptation changes. The only boundary it keeps, that a small familiar task needs no separate plan, concerns tasks that are already small, not how deep to split a complex task. A reader who splits a complex task has no signal where to stop.

evidence.text: 拆到什么程度合适：以「每个子任务能在一次坐下来的时间里做完」为准，拆得过细本身也耗时间

findings.fix_direction: Say how far to split, or state in the adaptation changes that the upstream stopping rule was left out because it has no source.

findings.text: B — seria eksperymentów w jednej publikacji; zweryfikowano kierunek wyniku, bez wielkości efektu.
findings.why: The letter B fits the README definition of a single study, and it matches the upstream grade. But the grade field says only that the direction was verified. It does not say that the check rested on the abstract alone, which the upstream note states. That fact appears only in the source link label and in Ograniczenia#2, where it is framed as a gap about experiments 3 and 4, not as the basis of the whole grade. A reader of the grade line alone may think the paper was read.
